newsitem.title: USA: Capital Gaming names Tracy chairman.
newsitem.headline: Capital Gaming names Tracy chairman.

text.p: Capital Gaming International Inc said it has elected president and chief executive Edward Tracy to the position of chairman of the board.
The company also said its reorganization plan was confirmed by the Federal Court for the District of New Jersey on March 19.

Its financial restructuring consisted of the issuance by the company of a combination of equity and debt securities in exchange for about $104.6 million in Senior Secured Notes, as well as all of the company's remaining unsecured debt.
As a result, the company has issued new debt securities consisting of $23.1 million in Senior Secured Notes due 2001.
